evals.prompt: Do a UX audit of these 5 screens of our trading app checkout: [screenshots].
evals.expected_output: A findings table using Nielsen's heuristics with evidence, severity 0 to 4, confidence, impact, effort and recommendations, plus quick wins and strengths.
expectations: Each finding has evidence, severity, confidence, impact and effort
Domain-dependent findings are marked lower confidence
Accessibility issues are routed to an accessibility audit
